blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Ambiguity in prescriptive text such as laws, contracts, rules, policies, or recommendations can be both desirable (e.g., if it enables a law to adapt to changing context, such as new technologies) and undesirable (e.g., if it leads to arbitrary discretion or conflict over the law's interpretation). To help navigate these trade-offs, it would be valuable to have methods for quantifying ambiguity that are predictive of such outcomes, but existing measures capture how text is perceived in isolation rather than how it is interpreted in context. In this paper, we propose quantifying ambiguity as the degree of disagreement among a set of stakeholders ("raters") on how alternative prescriptive texts ("policies") apply in each of a set of relevant scenarios ("cases"). Using two policy domains, we present preliminary analysis suggesting that, even when using simulated raters, this approach (i) correlates with real human disagreement, and (ii) is robust to spurious text features. We then apply the measure to existing deliberation datasets to describe the association between policy ambiguity and support for those policies.
blocks.zh: 诸如法律、合同、规则、政策或建议等规范性文本的模糊性既可取(例如,如果它使法律能够适应不断变化的环境,例如新技术),又不可取(例如,如果它导致对法律解释的任意裁量权或冲突)。 为了帮助实现这些取舍,有必要制定能够预测这些结果的模糊性量化方法,但现有措施反映案文是如何孤立地看待的,而不是如何在上下文中加以解释。 在本文中,我们建议量化模糊性,因为一组利害关系方("评分者")之间对于替代规范文本("政策")如何适用于每组相关情景("案例")的分歧程度. 我们利用两个政策领域,提出初步分析,认为即使在使用模拟测算器时,这种方法(一) 与真正的人类分歧相关;(二) 与虚假文本特征相关。 然后,我们将这一措施应用于现有的审议数据集,以描述政策模糊与支持这些政策之间的联系。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Ambiguity or vagueness is a consequential consideration when drafting prescriptive text such as laws, contracts, or policies.
Too much ambiguity, and it becomes difficult for citizens to understand the rules they must adhere to, while officials may have greater discretion to enforce rules selectively. For example, in the United States there is a “void-for-vagueness” doctrine in constitutional law which holds that criminal statutes may be void if they lack sufficient specificity, motivated by a view that “men of common intelligence cannot be required to guess at the meaning of [an] enactment” Congressional Research Service (2022) ; Amsterdam (1960) . The stakes can be national in scale: the 1995 Quebec sovereignty referendum failed by barely a percentage point on a ballot question whose wording left genuine doubt about what a ‘Yes’ vote would have mandated, and Canada’s subsequent Clarity Act now empowers the House of Commons to judge whether the question in a proposed referendum is sufficiently clear before it is held Parliament of Canada (2000) .
blocks.zh:
在起草法律、合同或政策等规范性案文时,含糊不清或含糊不清是一个必然考虑因素。
过于含糊不清,公民也难以理解他们必须遵守的规则,而官员则可能有更多的酌处权有选择地执行规则。 例如,在美国,宪法中有一种“避讳”理论,认为刑事法规如果不够具体,就可能无效,其动机是“不能要求共同情报人员猜测颁布法律的意义”国会研究处(2022年);阿姆斯特丹(1960年)。 1995年的魁北克主权公投在选票问题上只差一个百分点就失败了, 其措辞让人对“赞成”的投票有何授权产生真正的怀疑, 加拿大随后的《澄清法案》现在授权下议院在举行加拿大议会(2000年)之前,

blocks.en: But ambiguity can also be useful. Some degree of interpretive flexibility can allow legal rules to adapt to unforeseen circumstances, including technological or social changes that could not have been fully specified in advance. Ambiguity can also preserve discretion for judges, agencies, or other decision-makers tasked with applying general principles to heterogeneous cases. In political settings, ambiguity can facilitate compromise by allowing actors who agree on broad goals to defer disagreement over implementation details.
blocks.zh: 但含糊不清也可能有用。 某种程度的解释灵活性可以使法律规则适应出乎意料的情况,包括技术或社会变化,而这些变化不可能事先充分说明。 含糊不清还可以为法官、机构或其他负责对不同案件适用一般原则的决策者保留酌处权。 在政治环境中,模棱两可可促成妥协,允许同意广泛目标的行为者推迟对执行细节的分歧。

blocks.en: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to write and interpret policies, and have further been proposed as tools to augment democratic processes ( Tessler et al., 2024 ; Konya et al., 2025 ) , questions about how policy texts are interpreted and how ambiguity should be operationalized become ever more salient. Despite this, ambiguity remains difficult to formalize and measure. There are early signs that the problem is both tractable and consequential: Hall and Paschal (2026) find that scoring prediction-market contracts against a hand-built clarity rubric is enough to predict which contracts will later end up in dispute. But such rubrics must be engineered for each domain, and so far, a general, principled operationalization of ambiguity does not exist.
blocks.zh: 由于人们越来越多地使用大型语言模型来撰写和解释政策,并被进一步提议作为加强民主进程的工具(Tessler等人,2024年;Konya等人,2025年),关于如何解释政策案文和如何实施模糊性的问题变得越来越突出。 尽管如此,模糊不清仍然难以正式确定和衡量。 早期有迹象表明,这个问题既可拉动,又可导致: Hall和Paschal(2026年)认为,对照手工制作的清晰度标点的评分预测市场合同足以预测哪些合同日后会陷入争议. 但是,必须针对每个领域设计这种标题,而迄今为止,尚不存在笼统、原则性的模糊性操作。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Visual intuition for the DELTA framework. Given context on a policy domain, a set of alternative policies, a set of cases to which the policies might apply, and a set of raters , each rater judges whether each policy permits and whether it prohibits each case, and the two answers are averaged into a single judgment. For each policy, disagreement is computed across raters for each case and then averaged across cases, yielding a score that captures the ambiguity of the policy relative to the chosen cases and population of raters. Cases and raters may be human-provided or, as in LLM-DELTA, generated and simulated with LLMs.
blocks.zh: 图 1: DELTA框架的视觉直觉. 根据某一政策领域的背景、一套替代政策、一套政策可能适用的案例和一套评分标准,每个评分者判断每项政策是否允许,是否禁止每一案件,两个答案平均为一项判决。 就每项政策而言,对每个案例的评分者之间的分歧进行计算,然后对案例进行平均计算,得出一个分数,该分数反映出政策相对于所选案例和评分者人数的模糊性。 病例和评分器可能是由人类提供的,或像LLM-DELTA一样,由LLM-DELTA生成并模拟.

blocks.en: In our paper, we introduce DELTA , a framework for measuring ambiguity as interpretive divergence over consequences. DELTA evaluates a policy by pairing it with realistic application cases and asking a diverse set of raters whether the policy permits or prohibits each case. We incorporate LLMs to generate difficult evaluation cases, construct rater personas, and simulate judgments, producing a scalable approximation we call LLM-DELTA.
blocks.zh: 在我们的文件中,我们介绍了DELTA,这是衡量模糊性的框架,作为对后果的解释性分歧。 DELTA评价一项政策,将它与现实的应用案例联系起来,并询问不同的评估者政策是否允许或禁止每个案例。 我们加入了LLMS来生成困难的评价案例,构建速率人物,并模拟判断,产生一个可伸缩的近似值,我们称之为LLM-DELTA.

blocks.en:
Across four datasets, we present preliminary validation of DELTA as a methodological framework and use it as a tool for substantive analysis.
We first benchmark LLM-DELTA scores against DELTA scores obtained from a human-subject experiment, finding a substantial positive correlation in a single domain. In an adversarially constructed dataset, we show that DELTA recovers the intended distinction between consensus-inducing and disagreement-inducing policies, while direct LLM-as-a-judge ratings fail. We then apply the measure to two large-scale public discussions to test whether ambiguous statements are more likely to bridge disagreement. Contrary to the intuition that ambiguity facilitates compromise, we find null relationships: more ambiguous statements do not attract broader support, and they appear to soften strong agreement rather than convert opposition.
blocks.zh:
在整个四个数据集中,我们提出了对DELTA作为方法框架的初步验证,并将其用作实质性分析的工具。
我们首先将LLM-DELTA的分数与从人类实验中获得的DELTA分数进行比对,发现在一个单一领域有很大的正相关. 在对抗性构建的数据集中,我们显示DELTA恢复了预期的引出共识的政策与引出分歧的政策之间的区别,而直接的LLM-as-a-judge评分则失败了. 然后,我们将该措施应用于两次大规模的公开讨论,以检验含糊不清的言论是否更有可能弥合分歧。 与模棱两可有助于妥协的直觉相反,我们发现双方的关系是无效的:比较模棱两可的声明没有获得更广泛的支持,它们似乎软化了强烈的一致意见,而不是转化出反对。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Our approach to conceptualising and measuring ambiguity has connection to several large bodies of work from different disciplines. In this short survey, we aim to be reasonably comprehensive with respect to prior work on the narrow task of algorithmically quantifying degrees of ambiguity. We note also that use of terminology is not consistent in the literature; the general concept we refer to as “ambiguity” is sometimes also called “vagueness” Amsterdam (1960) ; Lebanoff and Liu (2018) , “specificity” Li and Nenkova (2015) or “concreteness” Yeomans (2021) , sometimes refers to different concepts (e.g., Ellsberg (1961) ), and is sometimes decomposed in various ways, such as by distinguishing between subjective uncertainty (where the interpreter finds a policy text unclear) and intersubjective disagreement (where different interpreters disagree about how a policy applies to cases) Farnsworth et al. (2010) ; Chen and Zhang (2023) .
blocks.zh: 我们的概念和衡量模棱两可的方法与不同学科的一些大型工作有联系。 在这项简短的调查中,我们的目标是,对于在算法量化模糊程度这一狭义任务之前所进行的工作,具有合理的全面性。 我们还注意到,术语的使用在文献中并不一致;我们所说的“含糊不清”的一般概念有时也被称为“模糊不清”阿姆斯特丹(1960年);Lebanoff和Liu(2018年)、“具体性”Li和Nenkova(2015年)或“具体性”Yeomans(2021年),有时是指不同的概念(例如,Ellsberg(1961年)),有时是以各种方式分解的,例如区分主观不确定性(解释者认为政策案文不明确)和主观分歧(不同的解释者对政策如何适用于案件持不同意见) Farnsworth等(2010年);陈和张(2023年)。

blocks.en: Several approaches have been taken to quantifying ambiguity. One cluster of papers approaches the task as a binary classification, labelling texts as ambiguous/unambiguous or general/specific Massey et al. (2014) ; Li and Nenkova (2015) ; Zhang and Ma (2023) , grounded in binary labels from human annotators. Slightly more granular approaches have humans score text on Likert scales capturing degrees of perceived ambiguity, and train models to predict those ratings Yeomans (2021) . One notable paper introduced a dataset of human-labelled “concreteness” scores for about 40,000 English words and n-grams, rated on a 5-point Likert scale from abstract to concrete Brysbaert et al. (2014) .
blocks.zh: 已采取若干办法量化含糊不清之处。 一组文件将这项任务视为二进制分类,将文本标为模棱两可/含糊不清或笼统/具体的Massey等人(2014年);Li和Nenkova(2015年);Zhang和Ma(2023年),以人类注释者的二进制标签为基础。 稍多一点的颗粒法在Irikrt尺度上有人类得分的文字, 一份值得注意的论文提出了一套以人类标记的“混凝土”计分的数据集,其中约40 000个英文单词和正克的分数从抽象到混凝土Brysbaert等人(2014年)按5分的相似度评级。

blocks.en: A second line of work builds disagreement between interpreters into the conception of ambiguity itself, rather than treating ambiguity as a property of the text as perceived by an individual reader. In natural language inference (NLI), annotators judge whether a hypothesis follows from a premise, a task closely analogous to judging whether a policy permits a case. Pavlick and Kwiatkowski (2019) showed that for many NLI examples, disagreement persists as more judgments are collected, and does not disappear when annotators are given additional context, indicating genuinely multiple plausible interpretations. Jiang and de Marneffe (2022) taxonomized the causes of such disagreement into semantic uncertainty, annotator-specific assumptions, and artifacts of the task itself, distinctions that loosely parallel our decomposition of disagreement into intra-rater indeterminacy and inter-rater disagreement. Chen and Zhang (2023) made a similar distinction operational in their Judgment Sieve workflow, separately measuring ambiguity (an individual’s uncertainty about an item, often due to limited context) and disagreement (divergence between individuals with different perspectives), and showing that targeting each with a matched intervention (adding context or deliberation, respectively) reduces both, whereas uniform interventions tend to trade one off against the other. This literature supplies the conceptual core of DELTA.
blocks.zh: 第二行工作使口译员对含糊不清的概念本身产生分歧,而不是将含糊不清视为个别读者所认为的案文的一部分。 在自然语言推论(NLI)中,注释者判断假说是否遵循前提,这一任务与判断政策是否允许案件的任务非常相似. Pavlick和Kwiatkowski(2019年)显示,对于许多NLI的例子来说,随着更多的判决被收集,分歧仍然存在,在给注解者额外上下文时不会消失,这表明真正有多种可信的解释. Jiang and de Marneffe(2022年)将这种分歧的原因分类为语义上的不确定性、特定注解的假设和任务本身的文物,这些区别与我们把分歧分解为战略内部的不确定性和战略内部的分歧大相径庭。 Chen和Zhang(2023年)在判决Sieve工作流程中作了类似的区分,分别衡量模糊性(个人对某一项目的不确定性,往往是由于上下文有限)和分歧(不同观点的个人之间的分歧),并表明以相应的干预(增加上下文或审议)作为目标会减少两者,而统一干预往往相互取舍。 这些文献提供了DELTA的概念核心.

blocks.en: Closest to our setting is work on rules written to govern AI systems. He et al. (2026) formalized the interpretive ambiguity of a rule as the entropy of compliance judgments across a panel of reasonable interpreters (instantiated as LLM judges), and adapted two mechanisms from the legal tradition to reduce it: iterative rule refinement at the rule-creation step, analogous to agency rulemaking, and prompt-based interpretive constraints at the rule-application step, analogous to canons of statutory construction. Approaching from the opposite direction, Clifford et al. (2026) studied the reconstruction of natural-language principles from preference data, and found that applying the resulting “constitutions” is itself ambiguous: different executors of the same constitution agree only 73% of the time, leading them to conclude that principles can only be evaluated jointly with their interpreters.
blocks.zh: 与我们的背景最接近的是 制定规范人工智能系统的规则 他等(2026年)将一项规则的解释性模糊性正式化,作为合理解释者小组(作为LLM法官)遵守判决的内涵,并从法律传统中调整了两种机制来减少这种模糊性:规则制定阶段的迭接规则的完善,类似于机构规则的制定;规则适用阶段的即时解释性限制,类似于法规的完善。 Clifford等人(2026年)从相反的方向出发,研究了从偏好数据中重建自然语言原则的问题,并发现应用由此产生的"宪法"本身是模糊的:同一宪法的不同执行者只同意时间的73%,导致他们得出结论,原则只能与他们的解释者共同评价.

blocks.en: Most of the measures above are validated against judgments elicited for the purpose rather than against disagreements arising in practice. An exception is Hall and Paschal (2026) , who found that LLM-assigned scores on a clarity rubric predicted which prediction-market contracts were later disputed (out-of-sample AUC of roughly 0.75). But such rubrics must be engineered for each domain, and so far, a general, principled operationalization of ambiguity does not exist.
blocks.zh: 上述大多数措施都是针对为此目的而做出的判决,而不是针对实践中产生的分歧作出的。 一个例外是Hall和Paschal(2026年),他们发现LLM分配的分数在清晰的分数上预测了预测-市场合同后来被争议(AUC样本外约0.75分). 但是,必须针对每个领域设计这种标题,而迄今为止,尚不存在笼统、原则性的模糊性操作。

blocks.en: The more automated versions of the algorithmic pipeline we introduce below include tasks of generating cases, generating personas (of raters), and for each policy-case pair, predicting whether a rater with a given persona would judge the case consistent with the policy. Versions of these tasks have been studied by others, for example work on case generation Perez et al. (2022) ; Feng et al. (2023) ; Kuo et al. (2026) , persona generation Park et al. (2022) ; Moon et al. (2024) ; Castricato et al. (2025) , case-based reasoning Feng et al. (2023) ; Chen and Zhang (2025) , and predicting the judgments of individual raters, both in annotation tasks with inherent disagreement Zhang and de Marneffe (2021) ; Davani et al. (2022) ; Lee et al. (2023) and in inferring opinions or votes on political and social issues Argyle et al. (2023) ; Bakker et al. (2022) ; Small et al. (2023) ; Fish et al. (2024) ; Gudiño et al. (2024) . We do not aim to advance state-of-the-art on these tasks with this paper, but expect that as performance on these tasks improves, those insights can be incorporated to improve our proposed ambiguity metric.
blocks.zh: 下面我们引入的算法管道的更自动化版本包括生成案例的任务,生成个人(评分)的任务,以及每对政策案例的任务,预测与特定个人(a)的评分员是否会按照政策判断案件. 这些任务的版本已由其他人研究,例如关于案例生成者佩雷斯等人(2022年);冯等人(2023年);Kuo等人(2026年)的工作,人格生成者。 Park等人(2022年);Moon等人(2024年);Castricato等人(2025年),案例推理 Feng等人(2023年);Chen和Zhang(2025年),以及预测个人评分员的判断,无论是在有固有分歧的张和德·马尔内夫(2021年)的注释任务中,还是Davani等人(2022年),李等人(2023年),以及推论对政治和社会问题的意见或投票时,Argyle等人(2023年);Bakker等人(2022年);Small等人(2023年);Fish等人(2024年);Gudio等人(2024年)。 我们的目的不是通过本文件推动这些任务的最新进展,而是期望随着这些任务的执行情况有所改善,这些见解可以纳入其中,以改进我们提议的模棱两可的衡量标准。

blocks.en: 3 Formalization
blocks.zh: 3 正规化

blocks.en: We begin with an abstraction: evaluating the consequences of a policy is equivalent to performing binary classification on its applicability to concrete scenarios. That is, given a case , one must decide whether it is consistent with the policy (e.g., permitted by it, or compatible with the position it expresses). Ambiguity arises when this mapping from cases to binary decisions is ill-defined or contested. In the same spirit as Farnsworth et al. (2010) ’s notion of intersubjective disagreement, we define the ambiguity of a policy as the expected disagreement among a diverse pool of raters regarding its consequences.
blocks.zh: 我们从抽象开始:评价政策的后果相当于对政策适用于具体情景的情况进行二进制分类。 也就是说,鉴于某一案例,必须决定它是否符合政策(例如,它所允许的,或与其表达的立场相容)。 如果从案件到二进制裁决的这种图谱定义不明确或有争议的,就会产生模糊不清。 我们本着与Farnsworth等人(2010年)一样的精神,将一项政策含糊不清的定义定义为各种评估者之间对其后果的预期分歧。

blocks.en: 3.1 The DELTA score
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 DELTA分数

blocks.en: We operationalize the above view through the DELTA ( Divergence Evaluation of Linguistic Text Ambiguity ) framework. Abstractly, given a policy, we construct hypothetical cases , and poll raters on whether they believe the case is consistent with, permitted by, or compatible with the policy. We then compute a disagreement measure over these judgments, where a value of zero indicates perfect consensus and higher values indicate increasing division among raters. The DELTA score of the policy is defined as an average of disagreement scores across the set of cases, with higher scores indicating greater ambiguity.
blocks.zh: 我们通过语言文本模糊性差异评价框架落实了上述观点。 简而言之,根据政策,我们构建假设性案例,并进行民意测验,以确定他们是否认为案件符合、允许或符合政策。 然后,我们计算出对这些判断的分歧措施,其中零值表示完美的共识,而高值则表明评估者之间的分化越来越大。 该政策的DELTA分数被定义为整个套案的分歧分数平均值,较高的分数表明更模糊.

blocks.en:
DELTA is an intentionally flexible framework: users can tailor the ambiguity measurement through their choice of cases and stakeholder distributions.
Consequently, DELTA scores are relative and are meaningful only for comparing policies within a shared evaluation setup.
Cases should be realistic yet engender debate regarding whether they are permitted or prohibited by the policy. Raters should be a diverse and broadly representative sample of domain stakeholders, so that their judgments capture a wide spectrum of viewpoints. This construction process reflects how policies are developed in practice: policymakers anticipate edge cases and potential conflicts that might arise during enforcement, so the policy language can be refined to preempt them.
blocks.zh:
DELTA是一个有意灵活的框架:用户可以通过选择案例和利益攸关方分布来调整模糊度量.
因此,DELTA的分数是相对的,而且只对在共同评价机制内比较政策有意义。
案件应该现实,但会引起关于政策是否允许或禁止这类案件的辩论。 Raters应当是一个多样化和具有广泛代表性的领域利益攸关方样本,以便其判断能够反映广泛的观点。 这一构建过程反映了政策在实践中是如何发展的:决策者预见到在执行过程中可能出现的边缘案例和潜在冲突,因此政策语言可以被完善来预先防范.

blocks.en:
Formally, suppose we have n n policies p 1 , … , p n p_{1},\dots,p_{n} in the same domain and wish to compare their ambiguity level. Assume we have already constructed cases c 1 , … , c m c_{1},\dots,c_{m} and found raters r 1 , … , r ℓ r_{1},\dots,r_{\ell} .
Given policy p i p_{i} , case c j c_{j} , we ask each rater r k r_{k} “does p i p_{i} permit c j c_{j} ?” and receive a binary answer q i ​ j ​ k q_{ijk} . Theoretically, if we then ask the rater “does p i p_{i} prohibit c j c_{j} ?”, the answer q i ​ j ​ k ′ q^{\prime}_{ijk} should be the complement, but in practice, this is not the case if p i p_{i} is only tangentially related to c j c_{j} .
As an example, consider the classroom AI policy “students cannot use AI for their homework” and case “a student uses AI to quiz herself on course material”. The policy clearly does not prohibit the case, but it also does not affirmatively address it; raters may therefore feel unable to confidently say either that the policy permits the case or that it prohibits it.

3.2 Approximation via language models
blocks.zh: 3.2 通过语言模型进行近似化

blocks.en:
To make our framework tractable at scale, we develop a systematic method for LLMs to perform the two core tasks that would otherwise require inordinate human effort: (1) generating a diverse set of challenging synthetic evaluation scenarios for a given collection of policies, and (2) generating a diverse pool of synthetic raters and simulating their judgments.
Full details of our prompts and model selections are presented in Appendix E .
blocks.zh:
为了使我们的框架具有规模,我们开发了一种系统方法,使法学硕士能够完成本来需要过度的人力努力的两个核心任务:(1) 为某一政策集产生一套具有挑战性的合成评价设想,(2) 产生各种合成评分器并模拟其判断。
我们的提示和模型选择的全部细节载于附录E。

blocks.en: To generate challenging evaluation cases, we repeatedly sample pairs of policies and prompt a reasoning LLM (GPT-5) to produce diverse cases, using the pair as inspiration. The model is instructed to craft cases that comply with one policy in the pair while violating the other if possible. Since policies typically express similar goals, the LLM must exploit the nuanced differences between the pair to fulfill the request; as a result, the output highlights precisely the details that give rise to disagreements in interpretation, especially with respect to other texts besides the input pair. Asking for a batch of cases induces a minimum amount of contextual variety; on the other hand, to avoid redundancy in the underlying cause of disagreement, we sample per batch to keep in the final set.
blocks.zh: 为了产生具有挑战性的评价案例,我们反复抽样对一对政策,并促使一个推理LLM(GPT-5)产生出不同的案例,利用对一对作为灵感. 该模型被指示处理符合一对一政策而可能违反另一对政策的案件。 由于政策通常表达类似的目标,因此LLM必须利用对等之间的细微差别来满足请求;因此,产出准确地突出了在解释上引起分歧的细节,特别是在输入对等之外的其他文本方面。 要求分批处理会诱发最小的上下文品种;另一方面,为了避免分歧的根本原因出现冗余,我们每批进行抽样,保留在最后一组.

blocks.en: To construct a diverse pool of raters, we prompt a reasoning LLM (GPT-5) with the policy topic and request short descriptions of stakeholder identities in batches. To encourage viewpoint diversity, identities are generated in opposed pairs (e.g., on the policy topic of campus free-speech, a pair might be a university administrator versus a student activist).
blocks.zh: 为了构建一个多样化的评分库,我们启动了一个具有政策主题的推理LLM(GPT-5),并要求分批对利益攸关方身份进行简短描述。 为了鼓励观点多样性,在对立的一对中产生身份(例如,在校园自由言论的政策主题上,一对可能是大学管理员,而不是学生活动家)。

blocks.en: In preliminary testing, we found directly asking an LLM to adopt a rater identity and issue a binary judgment yields a narrow distribution of responses, especially in non-reasoning models. Prior work has shown that persona-conditioned LLMs can approximate some human response patterns but exhibit demographic misalignment and prompt sensitivity Argyle et al. (2023) ; Aher et al. (2023) ; Santurkar et al. (2023) , and that richer agent state—e.g., natural-language reflection over memories and goals—can improve simulation fidelity Park et al. (2023) . To elicit more differentiated perspectives, we introduce an intermediate step: the model first expands each identity into a brief paragraph describing that stakeholder’s values and concerns regarding the policy topic, serving as a lightweight reasoning trace that anchors subsequent judgments in a more coherent viewpoint.
blocks.zh: 在初步测试中,我们发现直接要求一个LLM采用一个测评员身份,并发布二进制判断结果,反应分布很窄,特别是在不合理模型中. 先前的工作表明,有个人条件的LLMS可以大致了解某些人类反应模式,但显示出人口结构的失调和迅速的敏感性Argyle等人(2023年);Aher等人(2023年);Santurkar等人(2023年),以及较丰富的代理人状态——例如自然语言对记忆和目标的反射——可以改善模拟忠贞朴等人(2023年)。 为了获得更不同的观点,我们引入了一个中间步骤:这个模式首先将每个特征扩展成一个简短的段落,描述利益相关者对政策主题的价值观和关切,充当一种轻而易举的推理追踪,将随后的判断置于一个更加一致的观点中。

blocks.en: The final prompt provided to the LLM therefore includes the rater identity, their generated reflections on the topic, and the judgment question in both positive and negative framing. We use a relatively lightweight LLM, Gemini-2.5-Flash at temperature 1, to carry out the judgments.
blocks.zh: 因此,提供给LLM的最后提示包括了评分者的身份、他们对该专题的思考,以及正面和负面的判断问题。 我们使用相对轻的LLM,双子座-2.5-一等温下发光来进行判断.

blocks.en: 3.3 Score convergence
blocks.zh: 3.3 分数趋同

blocks.en: Figure 2: Each cell in the heatmap reports the average Spearman correlation between LLM-DELTA scores computed from a random subset of i i cases and j j raters and reference scores computed using the full evaluation design.

blocks.en: Repeated prompting of LLMs is known to yield diminishing returns in semantic diversity: newly generated cases or raters tend to resemble those already produced. Consequently, the marginal impact of additional samples on DELTA scores decreases over time, suggesting that a practical stopping criterion can be based on empirical convergence of the scores.
blocks.zh: 据了解,LLMS的反复催化在语义多样性方面产生逐渐减少的回报:新生成的病例或评分器往往类似于已经生成的病例。 因此,额外样本对DELTA分数的边际影响随时间推移而减少,这表明实际停止标准可以基于实际的分数趋同.

blocks.en:
We illustrate this using the Polis–Uber dataset introduced formally in Section 4.2 .
For each policy in this dataset, we first compute a reference LLM-DELTA score using the full evaluation design, with 60 generated cases and 30 LLM raters. We then estimate how quickly these scores converge by recomputing LLM-DELTA scores on smaller random subsets of the full design:
For each pair of subset sizes ( i , j ) (i,j) , we repeat the subsampling procedure 100 times, each time sampling i i cases and j j raters, compute LLM-DELTA scores on this subset, and calculate the Spearman correlation between the resulting policy rankings and the full-sample reference rankings. The heatmap reports the average correlation across the 100 iterations.

我们使用第4.2节正式提出的Polis-Uber数据集来说明这一点。
对于本数据集中的每项政策,我们首先使用完整的评价设计计算出参考LLM-DELTA分数,有60个生成的病例和30个LLM分数. 然后我们估计这些分数通过在全设计的更小的随机子集上重新计算LLM-DELTA分数而汇合的速度:
每对子集大小(一,j (一,j)),我们重复分样程序100次,每次取样i i 和 j 评分,计算LLM-DELTA在这个子集上的分数,并计算所得出的政策排名与全样本参考排名之间的斯皮尔曼关联. 热映射报告100个迭代的平均相关性。

blocks.en: The results show rapid convergence ( fig. 2 ). Correlations with the full-sample scores increase quickly as the number of sampled cases and raters grows, approaching high values well before reaching the full design of 60 cases and 30 raters. We note that this diagnostic establishes within-pool rank stability—that subsampling from a fixed pool of generated cases and personas yields similar rankings to the full pool—rather than convergence to the broader distribution of cases and personas that further generations could produce. With this caveat, we use the diagnostic as a practical stopping criterion across datasets, typically with 30 raters and at most 50–60 cases as a balance between score stability and computational cost. In future applications, researchers can use the same diagnostic to select an appropriate number of cases and raters empirically. Section A.4 reports the same diagnostic for our human subject study with similar results.
blocks.zh: 结果显示迅速趋同(图. 2),与全样本分数的关联性随着被抽样案例和评分数的增加而迅速增加,在达到60个案例和30个评分数的全面设计之前远接近高值. 我们注意到,这种诊断确定了集合内部的稳定性,即从固定的生成病例和个体中抽取的样本得出与全集合相似的排名,而不是与病例和个体的更广泛分布趋同,以便后代能够产生。 鉴此,我们使用诊断作为跨数据集的实际停止标准,通常采用30个评分标准,最多50-60个案例作为分数稳定性和计算成本之间的平衡。 在未来的应用中,研究人员可以使用同样的诊断方法,在经验上选择适当数量的病例和测定器. A.4节报告我们对人类研究的诊断结果类似。

blocks.en: 4 Methods
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we describe our hypotheses and approach to evaluating them.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们阐述我们的假设以及评估这些假设的方法。

blocks.en: 4.1 Hypotheses
blocks.zh: 4.1 假设

blocks.en: We had two hypotheses about the validity of the LLM-DELTA measure of ambiguity. First, LLM-DELTA scores would better correlate with human-DELTA scores than would other baseline ambiguity measures (including LLM-as-a-judge, and a measure based on word-level concreteness scores). When comparing ambiguity measures on a set of policies, we focus on rank correlation because the DELTA score is a measure of relative rather than absolute ambiguity. Second, LLM-DELTA scores would be more robust than the baseline methods to “adversarial” examples: policies that appear unambiguous (because they are worded in a way that sounds decisive), but that are actually ambiguous (because they lead to significant disagreement among a given population of raters when applied to a given set of cases), or vice versa.
blocks.zh: 我们对LLM-DELTA的模棱两可措施的有效性有两个假设。 首先,LLM-DELTA分数与其他基线模糊度测量(包括LLM-as-judge,以及基于单词级混凝土分数的测量)相比,LLM-DELTA分数更能与人-DELTA分数相关. 在比较一套政策上的模棱两可的衡量标准时,我们注重等级关联,因为DELTA分数是相对而并非绝对模棱两可的衡量标准. 第二,LLM-DELTA的分数将比基线方法更能衡量“对抗性”的例子:政策似乎毫不含糊(因为其措辞方式听起来具有决定性),但实际上是模棱两可(因为当适用于某一组案件时,它们会导致某一批评级人之间的重大分歧),或者反之亦然。

blocks.en: We had one substantive hypothesis, tested by applying the measure, that ambiguity in prescriptive text can help with consensus or agreement at the policy level by effectively postponing disagreement to future disputes about how the policy should be applied to individual cases. We hypothesize that this effect will be visible in real datasets as a positive relationship between ambiguity and various measures of consensus or bridging agreement Ovadya and Thorburn (2023) .
blocks.zh: 我们有一个实质性假设,通过适用这一措施加以检验,即规范性案文含糊不清,有助于在政策一级达成共识或协议,有效地将分歧推迟到今后如何将政策适用于个别案例的争端。 我们假设,这种效果在真实的数据集中将可见,作为模糊性与各种协商一致措施或过渡性协议(Ovadya and Thorburn (2023))之间的正关系.

blocks.en: 4.2 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.2 数据集

blocks.en: We worked with four disparate datasets, corresponding to multiple policy domains. The complete datasets can be found in our project repository .
blocks.zh: 我们与四个不同的数据集合作,对应多个政策领域。 完整的数据集可以在我们的项目存放处找到。

blocks.en:
For benchmarking LLM-DELTA and other measures against a human-DELTA baseline, we used the domain of university policies related to freedom of expression, particularly pertaining to speech about harm or violence. We (ourselves) wrote 20 alternate policies, designed to span from the highly ambiguous (e.g., platitudes about maintaining a “welcoming environment”) to highly unambiguous (e.g., modeled on the widely-used legal test for incitement). For cases, we paraphrased 20 real campus speech controversies from databases maintained by the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression (FIRE) Foundation for Individual Rights and
Expression (2026a) ; Foundation for Individual Rights and
Expression (2026b) ; Foundation for Individual Rights and
Expression (2026c) . Both policies and cases can be found in Appendix A .

For testing the robustness hypothesis, we developed a procedure for generating “adversarial” configurations of policies, cases, and rater personas (described in full in Appendix B ). In brief, it begins with a minimal example of two policies, two raters, and four cases such that the raters agree on all cases under one policy but disagree on all cases under the other, due to where the cases sit on underlying axes of consensus and conflict. For the results reported below, we generated one adversarial setup modeled on the 1999 Australian republic referendum and scaled it up to 20 policies, 32 cases, and 30 rater personas.
blocks.zh: 为了测试稳健性假设,我们制定了一种生成政策、案例和评分的“对抗性”组合的程序(附录B已详细叙述)。 简言之,它从两个政策、两个评分和四个案例的最低限度的例子开始,这些案例使评分者同意一个政策下的所有案例,但不同意另一个政策下的所有案例,因为案件处于共识和冲突的核心。 就下文报告的结果而言,我们在1999年澳大利亚共和国公民投票中产生了一个对抗性的设置模式,并扩大到20个政策、32个案件和30个人口比率。

blocks.en:
Pol.is is an online platform for large-scale deliberation and opinion mapping conducted in partnership with governments or civic organizations interested in broad public participation.
Given a policy topic, participants submit short position statements and vote on statements submitted by others.
blocks.zh:
Pol.is是一个在线平台,与政府或对公众广泛参与感兴趣的民间组织合作进行大规模审议和民意调查。
鉴于一个政策议题,与会者提交简短的立场声明并投票表决其他人提交的声明。

blocks.en: Although the statements in Pol.is conversations are not formal policies, they are policy-relevant texts where participants express what they believe governments ought to do, and we therefore treat them as directional policy proposals. In the DELTA framework, cases can be understood as policy implementations or decisions that might be evaluated against the proposal. Under this interpretation, it is still meaningful to ask whether a statement is ambiguous; that is, whether different raters disagree about the concrete actions supported and ruled out by the statement.
blocks.zh: 虽然Pol.is对话中的陈述不是正式的政策,但它们是政策相关文本,参与者在其中表达了他们认为政府应该做什么,因此我们把它们视为方向性政策建议。 在DELTA框架内,案例可以被理解为政策执行或决定,可以根据提案进行评估。 根据这种解释,问一个声明是否模棱两可仍然是有意义的;也就是说,不同评价者是否对声明所支持和排除的具体行动有不同意见。

blocks.en: We use four publicly available Pol.is datasets The Computational Democracy Project (2026) . The first concerns how Taiwan should regulate app-based ride-hailing services, collected as part of the vTaiwan participatory process that contributed to subsequent legislation vTaiwan (2023) . The remaining three are sub-topics drawn from Austria’s Klimarat process, a national citizens’ assembly on climate policy, covering production and consumption, housing, and energy Paice and Rausch (2022) . Full details are provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 我们使用四种公开的 Pol.is 数据集 计算民主项目(2026年). 第一个问题涉及台湾应如何管理基于应用的骑行服务, 其余三个是来自奥地利Klimarat进程的分专题,这是一个关于气候政策的全国公民大会,涉及生产和消费、住房、能源Paice和Rausch(2022年)。 详情见附录C。

blocks.en: Tessler et al. (2024) developed an AI system, the Habermas Machine , to help small groups of citizens identify common ground on social and political issues. The system takes as input individual opinion statements on a select topic and generates collective statements intended to reflect positions that the group could broadly endorse.
blocks.zh: Tessler等人(2024年)开发了一个AI系统"哈伯马斯机器"(Habermas Machine)来帮助小群公民在社会和政治问题上找出共同点. 该系统将关于特定专题的个人意见声明作为投入,并产生集体声明,旨在反映集团可以广泛赞同的立场。

blocks.en: The system was evaluated in a human experiment in the UK. Participants were assigned to groups of four or five and asked to deliberate on one of eight political topics (e.g., “should the minimum wage be raised in the UK?”). To begin, participants reported their personal agreement with the topic statement on a 1–7 scale and wrote a private opinion statement. The Habermas Machine then used these individual statements to generate collective statements representing possible common ground within the group. Group members then rated each collective statement according to their own level of agreement on a 1–7 scale, and a refinement iteration followed.
blocks.zh: 该系统在英国的一次人类实验中得到了评价. 与会者被分配到四至五人小组,并要求讨论八个政治议题之一(例如,“是否应在联合王国提高最低工资?” )。 首先,与会者报告了他们个人对专题说明1至7级的看法,并写了个人意见说明。 Habermas Machine随后利用这些个别声明生成集体声明,代表了集团内部可能的共同点. 小组成员然后根据自己的协议级别,对每一份集体声明进行1至7级的评分,然后进行改进。

blocks.en: For each discussion topic, we aggregated Habermas-generated collective statements across groups for ambiguity evaluation. This yields eight topic-specific sets, each with approximately 70 entries; full details of the experiment and our dataset construction are provided in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 就每个讨论议题而言,我们汇总了各组哈伯马斯产生的集体发言,以进行模棱两可的评价。 这产生了八套针对特定主题的集,每集约有70个条目;关于试验和我们数据集构造的全部细节见附录D。

blocks.en: 4.3 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.3 基线

blocks.en: For eliciting a human-DELTA ground truth, we conducted a human subject study where a politically-balanced sample of U.S. adults, recruited via Prolific, was asked to rate (policy, case) tuples from Dataset 1 described above. The consent form, instructions, and a sample of the rating interface are included in Appendix A . Each participant rated all 20 cases against two policies and was paid $6; the median completion time was 18 minutes. Each policy was shown to 30 raters in total, distributed evenly across self-identified Republicans, Independents, and Democrats, allowing us to estimate disagreement across a politically diverse group. This setup differs slightly from the LLM-DELTA setup used elsewhere in the paper where the same rater evaluates all policies against all cases, due to practical limitations of human-subject experiments.
blocks.zh: 为了了解人类-DELTA的真相,我们进行了一项人类主题研究,要求通过Prolific招募的美国成年人中政治上平衡的样本对上文所描述的Dataset 1的拖累(政策、案例)进行评分。 同意书表,说明书,以及评分界面的样本,见附录A. 每位参与者根据两项政策对所有20个案件进行评分,并支付了6美元;中位完成时间为18分钟。 每个政策都向总共30位评分者展示了,在自我认同的共和党人,独立党人和民主党人之间分布均匀,让我们可以估计政治多元化团体之间的分歧. 这种设置与论文中其他地方使用的LLM-DELTA设置略有不同,由于人主体实验的实际限制,同一评分器对所有案例评价所有政策.

blocks.en: As a lexical baseline, we use a dictionary-based measure from Brysbaert et al. (2014) . The dictionary contains approximately 40,000 English words, each assigned a human-annotated concreteness score on a 1–5 scale. For each policy, we identify words that appear in the dictionary (consistently above 85% of the full text) and compute the average concreteness score across those words. Since more concrete language is typically less ambiguous, we negate the resulting score so that higher values correspond to greater ambiguity.
blocks.zh: 作为词汇基线,我们使用Brysbaert等人(2014年)的以字典为基础的计量法。 该词典收录了大约4万个英文单词,每个单词都按照1–5的尺度分配了人类附加说明的混凝土分数. 对于每项政策,我们确定词典中出现的词(始终高于全文的85%),并计算这些词的平均具体度分。 由于更具体的语言通常不太含糊,我们否定了由此产生的分数,以便较高的价值与更大的模糊性相对应。

blocks.en:
We further establish two direct LLM-as-a-judge measures of ambiguity ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) . In these baselines, an LLM is given a policy to be rated on a 1–7 scale. We use two prompt variants. The first prompt defines ambiguity in standard dictionary-style terms, with higher values indicating more perceived ambiguity, while the second is designed to more closely mirror the DELTA mechanism: the model is asked to imagine plausible scenarios and assess the degree to which people with diverse viewpoints might disagree about the applicability of policy in those settings.
Full prompts and model choices are reported in Appendix E .
blocks.zh:
我们进一步制定了两项直接的LLM-as-a-judge的模糊性措施(郑等,2023年)。 在这些基线中,LLM被赋予了1至7级的评级政策. 我们使用两个即时变体. 第一个即时定义了标准词典式名词的模糊性,更高的值表示更感知到的模糊性,而第二个是设计来更紧密地反映DELTA机制的:要求该模型设想可行的情景并评估持不同观点的人在这些环境中对政策的适用性可能存在分歧的程度.
附录E报告了全部提示和模型选择。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Human-DELTA benchmark
blocks.zh: 5.1 人类-《多哈协定》基准

blocks.en: Figure 3: Spearman correlations between four computational ambiguity measures and the human-DELTA scores for the first dataset of 20 university free-speech policies, with bootstrapped 95% confidence intervals over 2000 iterations.
blocks.zh: 图3 斯皮尔曼在20个大学自由语政策的第一个数据集中,4个计算模棱两可的计量与人-DELTA的分数之间的相关性,在2000年的迭代中,置信间隔为95%.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Correlations between LLM-DELTA and human-DELTA on dataset 1, with raw scores shown on the left and rankings shown on the right. Each point represents one policy.
blocks.zh: 图4 LLM-DELTA与人地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地 每一点都代表一项政策。

blocks.en:
Figure 3 reports Spearman correlations between human-DELTA scores and four alternative computational measures from the first dataset.
Confidence intervals come from a stratified rater bootstrap: for each policy we resample raters with replacement separately within each party (Democrat, Independent, Republican) while preserving the original per-policy party distribution, and recompute the human-DELTA on each resample while holding the other variable fixed.
blocks.zh:
图3 斯皮尔曼在人类-DELTA分数和从第一个数据集算出的四个可选计算尺度之间的相关性.
信心间隔来自一个分级的评分靴:对于每个政策,我们用每个政党(民主党,独立党,共和党)内部分别的替换来重新对评分者进行分级,同时保留每个政党的原始分布,并在每个再生时重新计算人文-DELTA,同时将其他变量固定.

blocks.en: Human-DELTA and LLM-DELTA scores are positively associated in accordance with our hypothesis ( fig. 4 ), suggesting that the LLM-based procedure captures a similar form of interpretive disagreement to that observed in human judgments. This holds despite our not manually specifying the demographic or partisan characteristics of simulated raters, whereas the human experiment used raters balanced across Republicans, Independents, and Democrats.
blocks.zh: 根据我们的假设(图4),人类-DELTA和LLM-DELTA的分数是正面关联的,这表明基于LLM的程序捕捉到与人类判断中观察到的相类似的解释分歧. 尽管我们没有手动说明模拟测评员的人口特征或党派特征,但人类实验使用的测评员在共和党、独立党和民主党之间是平衡的。

blocks.en: By contrast, the dictionary-based measure shows little relationship with human-DELTA, suggesting that DELTA does not simply capture surface-level word choice. The direct LLM-as-a-judge ambiguity rating fares somewhat better than the dictionary measure, but its association remains weak and far below LLM-DELTA’s, likely because direct ratings are more sensitive to apparent vagueness or rhetorical style than to disagreement over downstream application.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,以字典为基础的测量显示与人-DELTA几乎没有关系,说明DELTA并不简单地捕捉出地表水平的字词选择. 直接的LLM-as-a-judge的模棱两可的评分比词典衡量要好一些,但其关联性仍然很弱并远低于LLM-DELTA,这可能是因为直接评分对明显的模糊性或修辞风格比对下游应用的分歧更为敏感.

blocks.en: Finally, the LLM-as-a-judge disagreement measure performs poorly relative to LLM-DELTA, despite being prompted with a description of the DELTA mechanism. This indicates that merely asking a model to reason abstractly about possible disagreement is not sufficient to reproduce DELTA scores, as it lacks the scaffolding through concrete cases and diverse judgments.
blocks.zh: 最后,尽管对LLM-DELTA机制作了描述,但LLM-as-a-judge的争议措施与LLM-DELTA相比表现不佳。 这表明,仅仅要求一个模型抽象地解释可能出现的分歧并不足以复制DELTA的分数,因为它缺乏通过具体案例和不同判断的脚手架.

blocks.en: 5.2 Adversarial robustness
blocks.zh: 5.2 反常稳健性

blocks.en: Figure 5: Each point represents one policy in the adversarial dataset. Both LLM-as-a-judge ambiguity ratings and disagreement ratings rank the policies in nearly the reverse order of LLM-DELTA.
blocks.zh: 图5:每一点代表对抗数据集中的一项政策。 LLM-as-a-judge的模糊评级和有分歧的评级几乎按照LLM-DELTA的倒序排列政策。

blocks.en: Recall that the adversarial policy set begins from a minimal example with two policy types: one that should elicit consensus among two raters, and is therefore unambiguous under DELTA, and one that should elicit disagreement, and is therefore ambiguous under DELTA. We then scale this construction to a full set of 20 policies, with ten policies of each type (and similarly scale up the two types of raters and four types of cases). DELTA successfully recovers this intended distinction in the richer evaluation design: it ranks the ten consensus-inducing policies as the ten least ambiguous policies.
blocks.zh: 回顾,敌对政策从一种最低限度的例子开始,有两种政策类型:一种政策应引起两个评级人之间的共识,因此在DELTA之下是明确的,另一种政策应引起分歧,因此在DELTA之下是模糊的。 然后,我们把这一结构扩大为一整套20个政策,每类有10个政策(并同样扩大两类评级人和四类个案)。 DELTA成功地恢复了在更丰富的评价设计中这一预期的区别:它把促成共识的十项政策列为最不含糊的十项政策。

blocks.en: As shown in fig. 5 , both versions of the LLM-as-a-judge baselines rank the adversarial policies in nearly the reverse order of DELTA, revealing their lack of robustness. The adversarial setup was designed to decouple apparent ambiguity from realized disagreement along a latent axis; the reversal thus demonstrates that direct LLM-as-a-judge ratings fail to discover the pitfall, even when explicitly prompted to reason about disagreement.
blocks.zh: 如来所显示. 5,两种版本的LLM-as-a-judge的基线几乎按照DELTA的倒序排列了对抗性政策,揭示出它们缺乏稳健性. 对抗性的设置旨在从潜在轴心上消除实际存在的分歧中明显存在的模糊性;因此,这种逆转表明,直接的LLM-as-judge的评级无法发现陷阱,即使有明确的理由解释分歧。

blocks.en: 5.3 Relationship with bridging
blocks.zh: 5.3 与桥梁的关系

blocks.en: Pol.is uses participant voting patterns to identify preference clusters. In the datasets we use, Pol.is identifies two primary opinion groups: participants within each group vote similarly on statements, while the two groups differ systematically. We use these algorithmically identified groups to examine the relationship between ambiguity and bridging .
blocks.zh: Pol.is使用参与者投票模式来识别偏好集群. 在我们使用的数据集中,Pol.is确定了两个主要的舆论小组:每个小组的参与者对发言进行类似的表决,而两个小组则有系统的差异。 我们利用这些经算法认定的团体来研究模糊和桥梁之间的关系。

blocks.en:
Bridging is the ability of a statement to garner support from two opposing sides on a topic. Let p A p_{A} and p B p_{B} denote the agreement rates for a statement among participants in groups A A and B B respectively. We define the bridging score as min ⁡ ( p A , p B ) \min(p_{A},p_{B}) . This measure is conservative: a statement scores highly only if both groups agree with it at high rates. Statements that are strongly supported by one group but rejected by the other receive low bridging scores.
Empirically, our definition closely tracks alternative cross-group alignment scores , such as p A ​ p B p_{A}p_{B} , used by Pol.is, and p A ​ p B + ( 1 − p A ) ​ ( 1 − p B ) p_{A}p_{B}+(1-p_{A})(1-p_{B}) , which is high when both groups tend to give the same response, whether agreement or disagreement. Our definition more clearly reflects shared endorsement: statements that can serve as common ground by attracting support from both opinion groups, rather than merely produce common rejection.
blocks.zh:
沟通是一份声明在一个议题上获得两个对立方支持的能力。 A组和B组的与会者同意发言的比例。 我们把桥接分数定义为分数(p A, p B)\min(p_{A}, p_{B). 这一措施是保守的:一个报表只有在两个集团都以高比率同意的情况下才能获得高分. 获得一组强烈支持但遭到另一组拒绝的言论获得较低的过渡分数。
从经验上讲,我们的定义密切跟踪备选的跨组对齐分数,例如Pol.is使用的p A p → B → p → B → p → B → P + ( 1 - p A) ( 1 - p B) p_{-A}p_{-B}+(1-p_{-A})(1-p_{-B}),当两个组都倾向于作出相同的反应时,无论是同意还是不同意,都很高. 我们的定义更清楚地反映了共同的赞同:通过吸引两个舆论集团的支持,而不只是引起共同的反对,这些言论可以作为共同立场。

blocks.en: Figure 6: LLM-DELTA and bridging show null or negative Pearson correlation across four Pol.is datasets, contrary to the intuition that ambiguity fosters broader support.
blocks.zh: 图6 LLM-DELTA和桥接显示四个Pol.is数据集之间无效或负的皮尔逊关联,这与模糊促进更广泛支持的直觉相反.

blocks.en: We find that ambiguity is not significantly associated with bridging in any of the four datasets at the 20% engagement threshold shown in fig. 6 . Across the full range of thresholds examined in section C.1 , no dataset shows a stable positive association—the direction the ambiguity-as-compromise hypothesis predicts.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,在图中显示的20%的接触阈值的四套数据集中,任何一套数据集的连接都没有明显的模糊性。 6. 在C.1节所审查的所有阈值中,没有任何数据集显示稳定的正相关系,即模棱两可的假设预测方向。

blocks.en: One interpretation of this absence of a positive association is that in public deliberation, ambiguity does not necessarily create common ground by permitting interpretive latitude: For a statement to attract support from both opinion groups, it may need to articulate a position that is thoughtfully responsive to the underlying question. Ambiguous statements, by contrast, may fail to reassure either side about what the proposal would imply in practice and be seen as counterproductive. In this sense, bridging may depend less on allowing for multiple interpretations than on identifying concrete solutions that both groups can endorse.
blocks.zh: 对缺乏积极联系的一种解释是,在公共审议中,模糊性不一定通过允许解释自由而形成共同点: 为了获得两个舆论集团的支持,声明可能需要阐明对根本问题有深思熟虑的立场。 相反地,含糊不清的发言可能无法使任何一方确信该提案在实践中意味着什么,并被视为适得其反。 从这个意义上讲,沟通可能不取决于允许多种解释,而取决于确定两个集团都能赞同的具体解决办法。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Collective statements are ranked from least to most ambiguous according to DELTA scores. Lines show smoothed shares of participant agreement ratings on the 1–7 scale. 95% confidence bands are obtained using 300 bootstrapping iterations.
blocks.zh: 图7:根据DELTA的分数,集体报表的排名从最低到最模糊. 线路显示参赛协议评分平滑 1–7分. 95%的置信带是使用300个靴子的迭代得到的。

blocks.en:
We complement this finding with an analysis of how ambiguity is associated with the degree of individual agreement using the Habermas dataset.
Here, we consider only collective statements from groups with at least one participant initially supporting the discussion topic and at least one opposed, since those with no initial disagreement cannot meaningfully test opinion change.
Within each topic, we rank statements by their DELTA score and normalize to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , then examine how the distribution of participants’ agreement level varies as ambiguity increases. This within-question ranking allows us to compare patterns across topics without assuming that DELTA scores are similarly distributed.
blocks.zh:
我们通过分析使用哈伯马斯数据集的个别协议的程度如何模糊不清来补充这一结论。
在这方面,我们只考虑至少有一名与会者最初支持讨论议题、至少有一名与会者表示反对的集团的集体发言,因为最初没有异议的集团不能有意义地检验意见的改变。
在每一个议题中,我们按其DELTA得分对声明进行排序,并正常化为[0, 1] [0,1],然后审查参与者协议水平的分布如何随着模糊度的增加而变化. 这种内置问题排名使我们能够在不假设DELTA分数分布相似的情况下,对各主题的规律进行比较.

blocks.en: Figure 7 depicts the distributional shifts in participant agreement as a function of DELTA. Most notably, as DELTA increases, the proportion of “strongly agree” drops significantly, while “slightly agree” and neutral responses gain by a comparable combined amount; the entire disagree side changes only modestly. This pattern reinforces the Pol.is finding: Highly ambiguous statements do not appeal to the initially opposed to produce a bridging effect, but rather have the additional downside of softening the enthusiasm of the initially supportive.
blocks.zh: 图7将参与者协议的分配变化描述为DELTA的一种功能. 最明显的是,随着DELTA的增加,“强烈同意”的比例大幅下降,而“略为同意”和中性反应得到一个可比的合计数额;整个分歧方只略有变化。 这种模式强化了Pol.is的结论: 含糊不清的言论并不吸引最初反对产生桥梁效应的人,而是在软化最初支持者的热情方面有额外的缺点.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We put forth a definition of ambiguity in prescriptive text as a divergence in interpretations of consequences. The DELTA framework operationalizes this view by making explicit the cases and stakeholder perspectives under which ambiguity is evaluated, enabling comparisons of policies beyond lexical properties alone. Our results further complicate a common view of ambiguity as politically useful: while ambiguity may sometimes enable elite bargaining or defer conflict, in the public deliberation settings we examined, it does not reliably produce common ground. Future work should improve rater simulation, refine case generation, benchmark the framework across additional domains and languages, and investigate whether DELTA can predict downstream implementation conflict in real policy settings.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了规范性案文中含糊不清的定义,作为解释后果的分歧。 DELTA框架将这一观点付诸实施,明确了评估模糊性的案例和利益攸关方观点,从而能够将政策比作仅是地名特性。 我们的结果进一步使关于模棱两可的共同观点复杂化,因为政治上是有用的:虽然模棱两可有时会促成精英讨价还价或推迟冲突,但在我们审查的公开审议环境中,它并不能可靠地产生共同点。 今后的工作应改进速率模拟,完善案例生成,将框架的基准跨出其他领域和语言,并调查DELTA是否能够预测实际政策环境中下游的执行冲突。

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en:
Our framework and findings come with several limitations.
First, LLM-DELTA depends on the capabilities and biases of the underlying language models used to generate cases, construct rater personas, and produce judgments. Although we observe a positive correlation between LLM-DELTA and human-DELTA on our university speech dataset (Spearman ρ = 0.48 \rho=0.48 ), this is a moderate rather than strong association, and it is established on a single domain with 20 policies. The extent to which LLM-simulated raters reproduce real interpretive disagreement in other policy domains, particularly those underrepresented in pretraining data, those involving non-English text, or those where stakeholders hold views that are systematically misrepresented in training corpora, remains an open empirical question. Prior work has documented that persona-conditioned LLMs exhibit demographic misalignment and prompt sensitivity, and our framework inherits these issues.
blocks.zh:
我们的框架和调查结果有一些局限性。
首先,LLM-DELTA取决于用来生成案例、构建速率人物和作出判断的基本语言模型的能力和偏见。 虽然我们在我们的大学语音数据集上观察到LLM-DELTA和Human-DELTA之间的正相关关系(Spearman $ = 048\rho = 0.48),但这是一个温和而非强烈的联系,它是在一个单一的领域建立的,有20个政策. 与LLM模拟的评级人在其他政策领域,特别是在培训前数据中代表性不足的领域,涉及非英文文本的领域,或利益攸关方持有在培训公司时被系统歪曲的观点的领域,复制真实的解释性分歧的程度,仍然是一个尚未解决的经验问题。 先前的工作证明,有个人条件的LLMs显示出人口结构失调和迅速的敏感性,我们的框架继承了这些问题。

blocks.en: Second, DELTA scores are inherently relative: they are only meaningful for comparisons within a shared evaluation setup (pool of cases and raters). Scores cannot be directly compared across studies that use different case sets or rater distributions, and the choice of cases and personas embeds assumptions about which scenarios and viewpoints are worth representing. Our case generation procedure samples policy pairs to surface points of nuanced disagreement, but it may systematically miss forms of ambiguity that only become apparent across larger sets of policies or in interaction with cases that no policy author would have anticipated.
blocks.zh: 第二,DELTA的分数本质上是相对的:这些分数只对在共同评价设置(案例和评分组合)内进行比较有意义. 在使用不同案例集或评分器分布的研究中,不能直接比较分数,对案例和人物的选择嵌入了值得代表哪些情景和观点的假设。 我们的个案生成程序将政策组合抽样到一些细微的分歧点,但它可能系统性地忽略了模糊性形式,而模糊性形式只有在更大的政策组合中才明显出现,或与任何政策作者都无法预料的情况相互作用。

blocks.en: Third, our human benchmark is limited in scope. We recruited 30 raters per policy in a single domain (U.S. university speech), balanced across self-identified Democrats, Independents, and Republicans, but this captures only one axis of viewpoint diversity in one context. The human study also differs from the LLM setup in that each human rater evaluated only two policies rather than all 20, which may affect comparability. The confidence intervals in fig. 3 hold LLM-DELTA scores fixed; so, for example, the relationship between LLM- and human-DELTA scores reflects variance in human judgments but not in LLM case generation, persona generation, or judgment sampling. We did not benchmark against human-DELTA in the Pol.is or Habermas datasets, so the validity of LLM-DELTA in those settings is supported only indirectly.
blocks.zh: 第三,我们的人类基准范围有限。 我们在一个单一领域(美国大学演讲)招募了30名评分员,平衡了自我认同的民主党人、独立党人和共和党人,但这只捕捉到一种背景下观点多样性的一个轴心。 人类研究也不同于LLM设置,因为每个人类评分员只评价两项政策,而不是全部20项政策,这可能影响可比性. 无花果中的信任间隔. 3持有LLM-DELTA分数固定;因此,例如,LLM-和人-DELTA分数之间的关系反映了人类判断中的差异,但在LLM案例生成,人物生成,或判断抽样中却并非如此. 在Pol.is或Habermas数据集中,我们没有以人-DELTA作为基准,因此LLM-DELTA在这些环境中的有效性只得到间接支持.

blocks.en: Fourth, the adversarial robustness result demonstrates that LLM-as-a-judge baselines fail on a setup we constructed precisely to expose their weaknesses. We do not claim that LLM-DELTA would prove similarly robust to adversarial constructions designed against it; such constructions are plausible and worth investigating in future work.
blocks.zh: 第四,对抗性强的结果表明,作为法官的LLM基线在我们为暴露其弱点而建立的结构上失败了。 我们并不声称LLM-DELTA会证明对针对它的对抗性建筑具有类似的强大性;这种建筑是可信的,值得在今后的工作中进行调查。

blocks.en: Finally, our bridging analysis is correlational and observational. We cannot identify whether the negative or null relationships between ambiguity and bridging reflect a causal property of ambiguous statements, selection effects in what kinds of statements get submitted to Pol.is, or features specific to online deliberation that may not generalize to formal policy drafting contexts. Our analysis also does not account for plausible confounds such as statement length, extremist rhetoric, or LLM-translation artifacts.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们的搭桥分析是相互联系和观察性的。 我们无法确定模糊和连接之间的消极或无效关系是否反映了模糊性声明的因果关系、向Pol.is提交哪类声明的选择影响,或在线审议的具体特征可能并不泛指正式的政策起草背景。 我们的分析也没有说明发言长度、极端主义言论或LLM翻译文物等可能存在的混乱。

blocks.en: We see limited direct risks from this work. DELTA is a measurement tool rather than a generative one, and it does not produce policy text, rank stakeholders, or make recommendations about which policies should be adopted. The most plausible misuse would be treating DELTA scores as objective measures of policy quality or legitimacy when they are in fact relative measures dependent on the chosen evaluation design; we have tried to be explicit about this throughout. A secondary concern is that using LLM-simulated raters in place of human deliberation, if applied uncritically in real policymaking contexts, could lend a veneer of stakeholder consultation to processes that have not actually consulted stakeholders. We view LLM-DELTA as a tool to support human judgment in early-stage policy drafting and analysis, not a substitute for genuine democratic participation.
blocks.zh: 我们看到这项工作的直接风险有限。 DELTA是一个衡量工具,而不是一个基因工具,它不产生政策文本,不给利益攸关方排位,也不就应采取何种政策提出建议。 最合理的误用是将DELTA分数视为政策质量或合法性的客观衡量标准,而事实上这些分数是相对的衡量标准,取决于所选择的评价设计;我们一直试图明确这一点。 次要的关切是,使用LLM模拟的评分器来取而代之,如果在实际决策中不加批评地加以应用,就可以使那些实际上没有征求利益攸关方意见的进程成为利益攸关方磋商的场所。 我们认为,LLM-DELTA是支持早期政策起草和分析中人类判断的工具,而不是真正民主参与的替代品。

blocks.en: 1. The university prohibits acts of physical violence or force on campus. Expression alone, in the absence of physical conduct or a true threat, does not violate this policy. 2. The university prohibits expression that constitutes a true threat: a serious expression of intent to commit unlawful violence against a specific person or group. 3. The university prohibits expression that is both (a) directed at inciting imminent lawless action and (b) likely to produce such action. 4. The university prohibits faculty and staff from advocating violence against identifiable persons while acting in their professional capacity. Expression outside that capacity is not covered. 5. Instructors may not present, as established fact in their teaching, claims contradicted by the consensus of the relevant field. Contested interpretations and opinions remain permitted. 6. The university prohibits expression that celebrates violence committed against a specific person. Expression about ideas, groups, or abstractions is not covered. 7. Instructors may not express personal hostility toward identifiable individuals in required classes. The same expression in voluntary venues is not covered. 8. The university prohibits expression that disparages an identifiable group on the basis of race, sex, religion, nationality, sexual orientation, or political affiliation. 9. The university prohibits expression that a reasonable person would interpret as encouraging others to commit acts of violence. 10. The university prohibits expression that creates a hostile environment for members of the campus community. 11. The university is committed to maintaining a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming learning environment for all members of its community. 12. The university permits criticism of public figures, including criticism delivered in harsh or intemperate terms. 13. Members of the campus community are expected to engage with one another in a spirit of mutual respect and civility. 14. The university affirms the principles of academic freedom and the free exchange of ideas as essential to its educational mission. 15. The university prohibits expression that undermines the dignity of members of the campus community. 16. The university supports the right of every student to learn in an environment free from intimidation, harassment, and discrimination. 17. The university values robust debate and the open contest of ideas, including ideas that members of the community may find objectionable. 18. The university values courage, including the courage to speak and the courage to listen. 19. The university affirms its commitment to truth. 20. Members of the campus community are expected to conduct themselves in a manner befitting the institution.

blocks.en: A.2 Cases
blocks.zh: A.2 案件数目

blocks.en: 1. An English instructor at the university shared an article on Instagram about the assassination attempt on Donald Trump, adding the comment: “If you’re gonna shoot, man, don’t miss.” The post was re-shared by the “Libs of TikTok” account on X (formerly Twitter), and gained widespread attention. 2. A group of students, posting under a social media account called “CanesCritters,” uploaded a video for a Digital Marketing class assignment in which a Black student is compared to a gorilla. 3. A professor in the Department of Asian and Middle Eastern Studies at the university, criticized the idea of free speech on campus, associating it with the rise of fascism, and mocked those who promote debate over resistance, saying the moral high ground is “for those who wish to drown in blood.” 4. A student, in a private group chat, described the January 6 Capitol breach as “a peaceful occupation of the capitol and our people were provoked with tear gas and flash bangs!” 5. A part-time math instructor modified the state’s mandatory Oath of Allegiance to align with her pacifist beliefs. The standard oath requires employees to “support and defend” the U.S. and California Constitutions “against all enemies, foreign and domestic.” She inserted the word “nonviolently” before “support and defend,” crossed out “swear,” and circled “affirm.” Previously, similar modifications had been accepted without issue during her employment with public schools. 6. An electrical engineering and computer science professor, author of a 1976 book called ‘The Hoax of the Twentieth Century’ which denies the systematic extermination of six million Jews during World War II, publicly endorsed Iranian President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad’s Holocaust denial statements, saying: “I congratulate him… It was about time an Islamic leader stated this publicly.” 7. An emeritus professor of medicine publicly supported physician-assisted suicide and the removal of Terri Schiavo’s feeding tube. (As context, Terri Schiava was a Florida woman who suffered severe brain damage in 1990 and was diagnosed as being in a persistent vegetative state. Her husband sought to have her feeding tube removed, arguing she would not have wanted to be kept alive in that condition; her parents fought to keep it in. The dispute went through years of court battles and became a national flashpoint in 2005, involving the Florida legislature, Governor Jeb Bush, Congress, and President George W. Bush, who signed emergency legislation aimed at keeping her alive. The feeding tube was ultimately removed and she died in March 2005.) 8. A student government denied Turning Point USA’s application for campus recognition, citing the group’s “misalignment” with university values, “confrontational language throughout the TPUSA website,” the national organization’s “Professor Watchlist,” and the group’s “actions of encouraging a growth in conflict rather than fostering communication.” 9. A psychology professor posted on Facebook in response to Charlie Kirk’s assassination: “Me thinks the word ‘karma’ is appropriate. Sad all the way around.” In a second post, she wrote: “But when we tell y’all that statistically … White American men are the most dangerous animals on the planet we’re wrong. Let’s not be hasty they say …” She then deleted the posts. 10. A psychology professor, when asked during a social psychology class about her views on NFL quarterback Colin Kaepernick’s national anthem protests against police violence, said she “would kill him.” 11. A student produced a “visual thesis” that focuses on Islamic extremism and criticized violence and bigotry against Israel. 12. A philosophy professor posted on Facebook: “I want the entire world to burn until the last cop is strangled with the intestines of the last capitalist, who is strangled in turn with the intestines of the last politician.” 13. Nine students, including two student journalists, participated in an unapproved “die-in” protest on campus to object to what they saw as the university administration’s failure to acknowledge faculty and staff safety concerns regarding its COVID-19 reopening plan. 14. A video circulated on Snapchat and Twitter showing an incoming student and two others laughing as one of them knelt on the chest of another who was saying “I can’t breathe.” 15. A math instructor wrote in a Facebook exchange that there were “no safe spaces in my classes” for students in the country illegally, and said he would report such students to Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). 16. A professor of industrial and systems engineering, public policy, and economics displayed a “Thin Blue Line” flag, commonly associated with the “Blue Lives Matter” movement, on his office door (“blue lives” refers to the lives of police officers). He said he aimed to present an alternative viewpoint and support law enforcement, asserting that “blue lives protect black lives.” 17. A professor of politics and global studies posted tweets about a Las Vegas mass shooting suggesting that “white male entitlement” was a contributing factor to mass shootings. 18. A part-time anthropology lecturer was involved in a confrontation with members of the campus College Republicans during a counter-protest to a pro-Palestinian event. The College Republicans accused the lecturer of attempting to grab a student’s sign and striking another student who intervened. The lecturer denied these allegations, asserting his commitment to nonviolence. 19. The School of Public Affairs invited Condoleezza Rice to speak on civil rights. Rice supported the war in Iraq, the use of torture on detainees, and helped implement other Bush administration policies. 20. Salman Rushdie, author of the 1988 novel The Satanic Verses, was invited by a college to deliver a commencement address. blocks.en: A.3 Study

blocks.en:
The study was determined to be exempt from ethics review by the university review board.
We recruited participants using Prolific and served the survey on Qualtrics.
Each participant rated all 20 cases against two policies and was paid $6; the median completion time was 18 minutes. Each policy was shown to 30 raters in total, distributed evenly across self-identified Republicans, Independents, and Democrats, allowing us to estimate disagreement across a politically diverse group.

该研究被确定不受大学审查委员会的道德审查。
我们利用Prolific招聘了参与者,并为资格调查服务。
每位参与者根据两项政策对所有20个案件进行评分,并支付了6美元;中位完成时间为18分钟。 每项政策都向总共30名评分者展示了,在自我认同的共和党人,独立党人和民主党人之间分布均匀,让我们可以估计政治多元化团体之间的分歧.

blocks.en: We used two attention check questions in the survey. They are presented as another case to rate per policy, and the order of cases is randomized. Seven percent of respondents failed at least one attention check; subsequently, we excluded their responses and recruited replacements.

blocks.en: Appendix B Procedure for generating adversarial examples
blocks.zh: 附录B 产生对抗性实例的程序

blocks.en: In this section, we describe the procedure used to generate the adversarial dataset referenced in section 4.2 . The goal of the procedure is to produce small, structured configurations of policies, cases, and rater personas in which two conceptions of ambiguity will lead to different assessments of the policies: ‘surface ambiguity’, the impression that a policy is vague, underspecified, or open-textured when read in isolation (as measured by, e.g., LLM-as-a-judge), and ‘operational ambiguity’: the disagreement that arises between interpretive communities when the policy is applied to concrete cases (measured, e.g., by LLM-DELTA).
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们叙述用于生成第4.2节所提及对抗数据集的程序。 程序的目标是对政策、案例和个人进行结构化的小构图,其中两个模糊概念将导致对政策的不同评估:`表面模糊 ' ,孤立地阅读(例如LLM-as-a-judge)时给人的印象是政策模糊、不具体或开放的印象,以及`业务模糊 ' :当政策适用于具体案例时,解释社区之间的分歧(例如LLM-DELTA衡量)。

blocks.en: B.1 Overview
blocks.zh: B.1 概览

blocks.en: Each adversarial example consists of two policies, four cases, and two rater personas representing two interpretive groups. The two policies are designed to invert the relationship between surface and operational ambiguity:
blocks.zh: 每个对抗性例子包括两个政策、四个案件和代表两个解释性群体的两个评估人。 这两项政策旨在颠倒地表和操作模糊的关系:

blocks.en: • Policy A (the consensus policy) is worded so as to sound ambiguous—it uses open-textured, evaluative, or rhetorical language—but yields agreement between the two groups on every sampled case. • Policy B (the conflict policy) is worded so as to sound concrete—it uses explicit, operational, or administrative language—but yields disagreement between the two groups, because its central terms encode a contested political, moral, institutional, or interpretive cleavage.
blocks.zh: · 政策A(协商一致政策)措辞含糊不清——它使用开放的文字、评价或口头语言——但两组之间就每个抽样案例达成协议。 · 政策B(冲突政策)的用词是使具体的——它使用明确的、可操作的或行政的语言——但引起两个集团之间的分歧,因为其中心术语是有争议的政治、道德、体制或解释分歧。

blocks.en: Policy A (the consensus policy) is worded so as to sound ambiguous—it uses open-textured, evaluative, or rhetorical language—but yields agreement between the two groups on every sampled case.
blocks.zh: 政策A(协商一致政策)措辞含糊不清——它使用开放文字、评价或口头语言——但两组之间就每个抽样案例达成协议。

blocks.en: Policy B (the conflict policy) is worded so as to sound concrete—it uses explicit, operational, or administrative language—but yields disagreement between the two groups, because its central terms encode a contested political, moral, institutional, or interpretive cleavage.
blocks.zh: 政策B(冲突政策)的用词是使具体化——它使用明确的、可操作的或行政的语言——但引起两个集团之间的分歧,因为其核心术语是有争议的政治、道德、体制或解释分歧。

blocks.en: A surface-level ambiguity judge—whether an LLM-as-a-judge prompted to rate vagueness on a Likert scale, or a lexical measure based on concreteness—is expected to rate Policy A as more ambiguous than Policy B. An operational measure such as LLM-DELTA, which estimates ambiguity from disagreement among diverse raters about how the policy applies to cases, should rank the two policies in the opposite order. The adversarial dataset therefore functions as a discriminating test between the two families of measures.
blocks.zh: 表面一级的模糊性法官——无论是一个LLM-as-a-judge促使将模糊性评为相似度,还是基于具体性的词汇衡量标准——都被认为比政策B更模糊。 诸如LLM-DELTA等操作性措施,估计因不同评定人对政策如何适用于个案的分歧而含糊不清,应把这两项政策置于相反的顺序。 因此,对抗性数据集在措施的两个方面是一种歧视性检验。

blocks.en: B.2 Latent dimensions
blocks.zh: B.2 次要维度

blocks.en: The construction relies on identifying two latent dimensions within a chosen policy domain.
blocks.zh: 这一构建依赖于在选定的政策领域内确定两个潜在的层面。

blocks.en: A feature of cases that both groups classify in the same way, even though they may disagree on adjacent normative questions. Policy A is written to key onto this axis: although its language sounds vague, both groups read it as picking out the same feature of the cases.
blocks.zh: 这两种情况的一个特征是,尽管在相邻的规范问题上它们可能存在分歧,但它们都以同样的方式分类。 政策 A是写在这个轴上按键的:虽然其语言听起来模糊,但两组都读作挑出案件相同的特征.

blocks.en: A feature of cases whose meaning is contested between the groups—typically a term that is operationally clear on its face but interpreted differently across interpretive frameworks. Policy B is written to key onto this axis: although its language sounds concrete, the two groups disagree about whether particular cases satisfy it.
blocks.zh: 案件的一个特征是,各群体之间对案件的含义有争议,典型的情况是,这个词表面上在业务上是清楚的,但不同的解释框架却有不同的解释。 政策 B是写到这个轴上的密钥:虽然其语言听起来很具体,但对于特定案例是否满足这一点,这两个群体意见不一.

blocks.en: The four cases are then drawn as a cross-product of the two axes. Each case takes one of two values along C C and one of two values along H H , yielding the target judgment matrix shown in table B.1 . Policy A produces uniform Y/Y or N/N judgments across the two groups (driven by C C ); Policy B produces split judgments (driven by H H ).
blocks.zh: 然后将这4个案例划为"两轴"的交叉出品. 每个案件都采用C C 沿线的两个数值之一和H H沿线的两个数值之一,得出表B.1所示的目标判断矩阵。 政策 政策B产生分化判决(由HH驱动)。

blocks.en: Table B.1: Target judgment matrix. Each case takes a value on the consensus axis C C (shared by both groups) and on the conflict axis H H (interpreted differently by the two groups); the notation “ H H favours G1” (resp. “G2”) denotes the value of H H on which Group 1’s (resp. Group 2’s) reading of Policy B leads to Y. Y denotes that a group judges the case to be permitted by, or consistent with, the policy; N denotes the opposite.
blocks.zh: 表B.1:目标判断矩阵。 每个案例都对协商一致轴C(由两个集团共同分担)和冲突轴H(由两个集团不同解释)具有价值; " H 偏好G1 " (参见 " G2 " )表示H的价值,即第1集团(参见第2集团)对政策B的解读导致Y。 Y表示一个集团判断案件是否得到政策允许或符合政策;N表示相反。

blocks.en: B.3 Construction procedure
blocks.zh: B.3 施工程序

blocks.en: To generate an example in a target domain, we follow nine steps.
blocks.zh: 为了在目标领域树立榜样,我们遵循了9个步骤。

blocks.en: 1. Choose a domain with both (i) recognisable implementation distinctions that different stakeholders agree on, and (ii) contested concepts that different stakeholders interpret differently. 2. Define two groups that plausibly partition the relevant population along an interpretive cleavage rather than along an outcome preference. Each group is specified by what it values, how it interprets key terms in the domain, and what kinds of implementations it sees as legitimate or illegitimate. Group labels should reflect interpretive stance rather than partisanship or desired outcome. 3. Identify a consensus axis C C on which the two groups predictably agree. The axis should be a relatively concrete feature of cases even though the policy describing it will be worded vaguely. 4. Identify a conflict axis H H on which the two groups predictably disagree, corresponding to a real political, moral, institutional, or interpretive cleavage in the domain. Each group should have a principled reading of the contested term. 5. Write Policy A so that it tracks C C but uses surface-ambiguity cues such as open-textured evaluative adjectives, rhetorical contrasts, and value-laden but underspecified language. 6. Write Policy B so that it tracks H H but uses surface-concreteness cues such as enumerated criteria, named harms, explicit institutional objectives, rights, or measurable-sounding outcomes. 7. Generate the four cases as the cross-product of C C and H H . Cases should be ecologically realistic—drawn from the kinds of proposals, programs, or incidents that actually arise in the domain—rather than artificial edge cases or technical loopholes. 8. Explain each judgment. For every cell in the matrix, give a one- or two-sentence rationale for why each group reaches its Y or N verdict. The exercise serves as a verification step: if a cell’s rationale is forced or implausible, the policy wording, group definition, or case is revised. 9. Verify the matrix against table B.1 . Examples that intentionally depart from the standard matrix are flagged explicitly and the departure is justified.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 选择一个有以下两种特点的领域:(一) 不同利益攸关方同意的可识别的执行区别;(二) 不同利益攸关方有不同解释的有争议概念。 2. 界定两个群体,按照解释性裂口,而不是按照结果偏好,合理划分有关人口。 每个组由它重视什么,它如何解释域内的关键名词,以及它认为哪些类型的执行是合法的或非法的来指定. 团体标签应反映解释性立场,而不是党派立场或期望的结果。 3. 确定一个协商一致的轴心C,两个小组可以预测地对此达成一致意见。 轴心应该是案件的一个相对具体的特点,尽管描述它的政策措辞会模糊。 4. 确定冲突轴H,预计这两个群体对此有分歧,相当于该领域中真正的政治、道德、体制或解释分歧。 每一组应对有争议的术语进行原则解读。 5. 写作政策 一种是跟踪C,但使用表面模糊的提示,如开放文字的评价形容词、花言巧语对比和价值拉开但描述不足的语言。 6. 写作政策 B从而跟踪H,但使用表层混凝土提示,如所列举的标准,命名的伤害,明确的机构目标,权利,或可衡量的结果等. 7. 产生这4个案例作为C和H的交叉产品。 案例应具有生态现实性——从实际发生在域内的各种提案、方案或事件中抽取,而不是人为的边缘案例或技术漏洞。 8. 解释每项判决。 对于矩阵中的每个单元,给出一个一或两个判决理由,说明为什么每个单元都得出Y或N判决。 这项工作是一个核查步骤:如果一个单元的理由被强迫或不可信,则政策措辞、群体定义或情况都会被修改。 9. 对照表B.1核查汇总表。 有意偏离标准矩阵的例子被明确标出,而且偏离是合理的。

blocks.en: B.4 Rater personas
blocks.zh: B.4 鼠标人

blocks.en: Each group is operationalised as one or more rater personas: third-person descriptions of how a person within that interpretive community thinks about the domain, what they value, and how they interpret the contested terms in Policy B. Personas are written without self-reference to their group and use plausible role labels rather than outcome labels. At the minimal scale, one persona per group is produced. When more personas are added (see section B.6 ), the role, vocabulary, and specific concerns are varied while the underlying interpretive stance is preserved, so that within-group stylistic variation can be distinguished from between-group disagreement.
blocks.zh: 每个群体都作为一个或多个评价人进行操作:第三人称描述解释社区内的人如何看待这个领域,他们重视什么,以及他们如何解释政策B中有争议的术语。 Personas的写作没有自我参考他们的群体,而是使用可信的角色标签而不是结果标签。 在最低限度上,每组生产一人。 当添加了更多人称(见B.6节)时,角色,词汇和具体关注事项各有不同,而基础解释立场则得以保留,这样可以区分组内结构上的差异和组间分歧.

blocks.en: When real respondents are used in place of LLM personas, groups are derived empirically from a small set of anchor items diagnostic of the interpretive commitments, using rule-based scoring, latent-class analysis, or clustering. Groups are validated by checking that within-group agreement on anchor items is high, between-group disagreement is high, and assignments are stable on held-out items.
blocks.zh: 当使用真实的答卷人代替LLM人物时,从经验上总结出一组对解释性承诺进行诊断的起锚项目,采用基于规则的评分、潜在类分析或分组分析。 通过检查组内关于锚地项目的协议是否高,组间分歧是否高,被搁置项目的任务是否稳定来验证组.

blocks.en: B.5 Quality criteria
blocks.zh: B.5 质量标准

blocks.en: A candidate example is accepted only if it satisfies the following criteria.
blocks.zh: 只有符合下列标准时,才接受候选例子。

blocks.en: • Surface plausibility. Policy A reads as vague or open-textured to an unprimed reader, and Policy B reads as concrete or operational. • Operational behaviour. On the sampled cases, Policy A produces inter-group agreement and Policy B produces inter-group disagreement. • Charitable groups. Both groups have principled, internally consistent reasons for their judgments. Neither is portrayed as irrational, malicious, or caricatured. • Ecological realism. The cases are recognisable as plausible members of the domain—close to real policy instruments, programs, or disputes — and not dependent on obscure technical loopholes, semantic tricks, or unrealistic hypotheticals. • Boundary distance. The Y/Y and N/N cases under Policy A are far enough from the consensus boundary that accidental within-policy-A disagreement is unlikely.
blocks.zh: • 表面可信度。 政策 A读起来含糊不清,或对未编辑的读者开放,而政策B读起来是具体或可操作的。 • 业务行为。 在抽样案件中,政策A产生集团间协议,政策B产生集团间分歧。 • 慈善团体。 这两个团体都具有原则性、内部一贯的判断理由。 也没有被描述为非理性、恶意或讽刺。 • 生态现实主义。 这些案件被确认为这个领域的可信成员——接近于真正的政策工具、程序或争端——而不是依赖于模糊的技术漏洞、语义诡计或不切实际的假设。 • 边界距离。 政策A下的Y/Y和N/N案件与共识界限相去甚远,即政策A内部的意外分歧不太可能发生。

blocks.en: B.6 Scaling within a domain
blocks.zh: B.6 某一领域内的扩大

blocks.en: The default output of the procedure is a minimal set of two policies, four cases, and two rater personas. Three orthogonal directions of scaling are available within a single domain:
blocks.zh: 程序的默认产出是一套最低限度的2个政策,4个案例和2个rater personas. 在一个单一的域内有三种正向的缩放方向:

blocks.en: 1. Paraphrase variation. Multiple wordings of Policy A and Policy B are generated, preserving the consensus or conflict axis but varying surface vocabulary. Paraphrases test whether the operational pattern is robust to wording. They are not treated as independent conceptual examples. 2. Cell variation. Additional realistic cases are generated within each cell of the matrix. This produces a larger case set while preserving the four-cell structure. Cell counts need not be uniform; we favour ecologically realistic frequencies over balanced quotas. 3. Rater paraphrase. Additional personas are generated within each group, varying role and vocabulary while preserving the interpretive stance. This allows within-group stylistic variation to be distinguished from between-group disagreement.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 譬喻变相. 产生了政策A和政策B的多种措辞,保留了共识或冲突轴心,但表面词汇各不相同。 参数检验业务模式对措辞是否有力。 它们不被视为独立的概念性例子。 2. 细胞变化。 在矩阵的每个单元格中都产生更多的现实案例。 这在保留四细胞结构的同时产生了更大的大小写集. 细胞计数不必统一;我们倾向于生态现实的频率,而不是均衡的配额。 3. Rater 作解释。 在每个群体内产生更多的人、不同的角色和词汇,同时保留解释性的立场。 这样可以区分组内结构上的差异与组间分歧.
